title: Email/import accepts empty mailboxIds without error
description: email.rs handle_email_import validates that mailboxIds is present (non-null), but does not check that it is non-empty. When the client sends mailboxIds:{} the code collects an empty Vec and calls backend.import_email(..., &[], ...). RFC 8621 §5.7: 'At least one mailbox MUST be given.' Fix: after extracting mailbox_ids check .is_empty() and return notCreated with invalidProperties:[mailboxIds] if so.
